decision.live_ready_reason: A two-month quote-only search cannot establish long-term profitability or paper readiness without multi-year walk-forward and live/paper evidence.
decision.reason: No train-selected standalone MBP-1 2R strategy passed the 70% win-rate, trade-count, and positive-PnL holdout gates.

method.long_term_limit: Only covers the provided two-month tick window, so passing this report alone cannot satisfy long-term/live-ready requirements.
method.sampling: Last quote per second; entries and exits use top-of-book bid/ask.
method.scope: Standalone quote microstructure search on Databento MBP-1 normalized quote files.
method.selection: Chronological first half selects specs; second half is untouched holdout.
